records.requirementOrFinding: The explicit `clipAlpha` masks cut only forbidden air; they never supply opacity or colour. Every required target pixel was measured as alpha255, every outside pixel as alpha0. The floor original contains painted checkerboard in its air; measured monotone registration samples only inside its books and the mask removes all air. No checkerboard colour cleanup or hand-painted replacement pixels was used. The two newly generated ceiling/courtyard sources use magenta background processed by the already registered importer.
